limitations.note: The rewrite eliminated the erroneous green assertion during red, but it also replaced the registered light and timer-reload pipeline with immediate state decoding, changing the cycle-by-cycle timing and asserting red during reset.
The test expected the rewrite’s immediate red output during reset and its direct phase transitions, so it passed without detecting the loss of the original reset and output timing.

limitations.quote: If the reload predicates already have the expected polarity, check whether the visible outputs are registered.
limitations.note: The agent read relevant guidance about registered outputs and timer reloads, but it did not use that guidance to preserve the existing pipeline.
